---
mode: agent
description: Capture a solved problem as a reusable note.
---

Follow the `compound-learnings` skill in this repository
(`skills/compound-learnings/SKILL.md`).

`${input:context}` may describe what was solved. Then:

- Write `docs/devflow/solutions/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.md` from
  `templates/solution.md`.
- Capture the root cause, the signs that recognize it again, and a concrete
  guardrail.
- Add searchable tags so the next run finds it.
